items.author: Austin Krell

Dean Wade on VJ Edgecombe:

"I love the way he plays. I really do. Any time I get out there on his team, I love it. He's flying around in transition, he's making the right cuts, he's sacrificing shots for people. He plays the right way and it's so fun to be on his team."

items.title: “I love Dean Wade,” Tyrese Maxey says and repeats. “I can already tell, man.”
items.author: Adam Aaronson
items.body_excerpt:
“I love Dean Wade,” Tyrese Maxey says and repeats. “I can already tell, man.”

Maxey says Wade is a “funny guy, a stand-up guy” and that he plans to get on Wade about shooting as many threes as possible. 

“He knows how to star in his role… He’s a great teammate, too.”

New Sixer Dean Wade is at the DICK’s Sporting Goods in King of Prussia, hosting his Back-to-School Shopping Bash for 10 youth from the Boys & Girls Clubs of Philadelphia. 

Each participant received $150 to shop for school essentials, sporting goods, apparel, and more.
